title: Place-set binding
description: A twin 'place set': the set of published twin ids one Kami entity senses through (architecture §3). Deliberately ignorant of the platform beyond entity_id. Ids are minted only by the twin; membership is the platform's guess until a steward freezes it.

placeId.description: A twin id, exactly sources/ids-schema.json line 13. Never invented by the platform.

binding_version.description: Immutable per version; changing anything creates a new one.

entity_id.description: Platform id; not a twin id.

anchor.description: The place whose headline need leads the page.

stream_id.description: place/<stream> once the twin mints stream places (PRD §9.1 #4); null until then.

commons_handle.description: front-range-bioregion vault path, read-only, e.g. wiki/places/named/boulder-creek.

members.description: Every twin id the entity may sense through.

name.description: Display name at freeze time; the twin's name is authoritative.

boundary.description: URLs only; the platform stores no geometry.

needs.description: 4–6 in practice; how they become meters is architecture §9.

property.description: A twin reading property (closed vocabulary) or a live-layer property such as dm.

membership_rule.description: How membership was derived — the platform's guess, in words.

reviewed_by.description: The steward who froze it; null while it is still the platform's guess.

twin_index_etag.description: id/index.json ETag at freeze; null when unknown.
